result_boundary: For records generated by free emitter Cauchy data, bipartite A-K parity makes the absolute-g^2 detector term vanish. The first feedback is absolute g^3, relative g^2 to the leading signal, and its exact retarded operator is exported. A two-emitter inverse fixture verifies the order and coefficient through g^3, while the nonzero leading determinant remains the constant term of the formal recoil ring. The numerical detector coefficient is input-blocked on serialized compact preparations, exact switches, evaluated massive Green images, and resulting detector integrals. Emitter stress/backreaction, finite-parameter/all-orders Green theory, full Dirac algebra, and quantum claims remain open.
